local.notes: The ComfyUI on this machine. output_root = the project's subtree of ComfyUI's output folder; output_prefix = what graphs put in front of their save path.

_example_remote.notes: Rename to the server's alias (comfy4) or delete. kind aws = looked up by EC2 Name tag; kind ssh = fixed host (add "host"). port = local tunnel port. output_root = a local mirror of the server's output folder (NAS), used when the tunnel is down.
